**Yes, but not by Sarah Chen alone.** Acme is eligible for a $1,000,000 limit once the parent guarantee is counted. Under the 2026 Credit Policy, the request needs approval from the Director of Finance (Elena Novak) and concurrence from VP Sales (Michael Torres).

**Request.** CR-9203 matches the system of record (`credit_requests.csv`) in every field. It asks to raise the limit from $250,000 to $1,000,000. Sarah Chen submitted it on 2026-09-23, relying on the Acme Group parent guarantee.

**Customer.** ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" is the same company as CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing." Both show DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee. CRM records the account as **Strategic**. Acme Industrial Supply Co. (C-1044 / CRM-2091) is a separate company.

**Policy.** Credit Policy 2026 applies, effective 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**Payment history.** The 2026 policy fails a customer for any invoice due in the 12 months before the request that was paid, or left unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date. Acme has no such invoice:
- INV-60412 was due 2025-11-28 and paid 2025-11-24.
- INV-62011 was due 2026-07-25 and paid 2026-07-22.
- INV-62305 ($720,000) is not due until 2026-10-02, so it falls outside the test.

**Maximum limit.**
- The Strategic maximum is $750,000.
- Guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 adds $400,000. The guarantor is Acme Group Holdings, Inc., and it names Acme Mfg. Holdings. It runs from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31, so it was in force on the request date.
- The maximum is therefore **$1,150,000**, and $1,000,000 is within it.
- Without the guarantee, the request would exceed the $750,000 maximum.

**Authority.**
- Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive and has no credit approval authority under the policy.
- A limit above $500,000 requires approval from the **Director of Finance, Elena Novak**.
- Because Acme is a Strategic account and the limit is above $500,000, **VP Sales concurrence** is also required. That role is held by **Michael Torres**.
- Neither of them submitted the request, so the rule against approving your own request does not apply.

**Worth noting (does not block the decision).** Sarah's email to Priya Shah refers to a "CR-9201" request to raise the limit to $400,000. That request does not appear in the system of record.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "CR-9203", "customer": "Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001; CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing)", "current_limit": 250000, "requested_limit": 1000000,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "guarantee"},
  "eligibility": {"status": "eligible", "maximum_limit": 1150000,
                  "basis": "Credit Policy 2026: Strategic maximum $750,000 plus parent guarantee GRT-ACME-2026 ($400,000, Acme Group Holdings, Inc., naming Acme Mfg. Holdings, in force 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31); no invoice due in the prior 12 months paid or unpaid more than 30 days after due date",
                  "late_invoices": []},
  "authority": {"policy": "CREDIT-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Director of Finance (limits > $500,000) with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic accounts > $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": ["structured/credit_requests.csv (CR-9203)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2048, Strategic)", "structured/erp_credit.csv (C-1001 limit 250000)", "structured/erp_invoices.csv (INV-60412, INV-62011, INV-62305)", "documents/credit_policy_2026.md", "documents/acme_parent_guarantee.md (GRT-ACME-2026)", "documents/organization_chart.md", "structured/employees.csv"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Sarah Chen's email of 2026-09-23 refers to a credit request CR-9201 ($250,000 to $400,000) that does not appear in Northstar ERP; confirm it is superseded by CR-9203 or withdrawn", "who": "Sarah Chen / Priya Shah", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
